brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir danced in the courtyards of Al-Aqsa Mosque, then appeared the day before threatening a Palestinian prisoner with death and execution, according to Shehab Wire. The dual actions move beyond individual provocation, according to political affairs writer Dr. Amira Fouad Al-Nahhal.

Ben Gvir's mosque visit and prisoner threat reflect a broader pattern of incitement, the analysis suggests, framing the incidents as part of a coordinated approach rather than isolated events.

title: Israeli minister dances at Al-Aqsa, threatens Palestinian prisoner
